verdict.rationale: OpenCode's docs say `opencode serve` runs a headless HTTP server that exposes an OpenAPI endpoint. A live probe confirms a downloadable spec at https://opencode.ai/openapi.json (HTTP 200, contains an "openapi" key), so a machine-readable spec is both documented and retrievable. Missing for 10: documentation of the spec's coverage and versioning, and independent community corroboration of using the spec.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)

citations.quote: The `opencode serve` command runs a headless HTTP server that exposes an OpenAPI endpoint that an opencode client can use.
PROBE openapi: HTTP 200 at https://opencode.ai/openapi.json — contains "openapi" key
